findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "format_whatsapp_text" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Convert the user's Markdown source to text ready to paste into WhatsApp. Before calling, copy the supplied source unchanged into text: do not Markdown-escape it…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: normalize_whatsapp_numbers, style_whatsapp_text, get_conversation_snapshot · Private data: normalize_whatsapp_numbers, demo_whatsapp_wrapped, disconnect_conversation · Public sink: generate_whatsapp_link, format_whatsapp_text, normalize_whatsapp_numbers, demo_whatsapp_wrapped, style_whatsapp_text · Destructive: format_whatsapp_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: normalize_whatsapp_numbers, style_whatsapp_text, get_conversation_snapshot · Private data: normalize_whatsapp_numbers, demo_whatsapp_wrapped, disconnect_conversation · Public sink: generate_whatsapp_link, format_whatsapp_text, normalize_whatsapp_numbers, demo_whatsapp_wrapped, style_whatsapp_text · Destructive: format_whatsapp_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
